{{Quote|Ladies and gentlemen: the monstrous; the fearsome; Wicket!|Masher, before revealing Wicket Wystri Warrick to a crowd and frightening the mimph|<ref name="Mimphs" />}}
A '''mimph''' lived in a [[Mimph village|village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] and cared for a [[mimph]] [[Unidentified mimph infant|infant]]<ref name="Mimphs" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of the [[mimph]]|[[Gone With the Mimphs]]}}</ref> a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] team led by the mimph [[Masher]] captured the young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and brought him back to the [[City/Legends|village]], where they tied him behind a curtain. When the curtain was drawn and Warrick was revealed, the mimph was frightened by the comparatively enormous Ewok and shrieked as they used their [[Limb/Legends|hand]] to shield the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the [[Youngling/Legends|infant]].<ref name="Mimphs" />

Like most of their [[Species/Legends|species]], the mimph was diminutive, with [[Color/Legends|pink]] and pale [[Hair/Legends|fur]], and white eyes with black pupils. They wore a green dress and a wide-brimmed [[Hat/Legends|hat]] with an adorning yellow [[Plant/Legends|flower]]. While they were frightened by the sight of the much larger Ewok, they still held concern for the young mimph in their care and shielded the infant's eyes.<ref name="Mimphs" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mimph appeared in "[[Gone With the Mimphs]],"<ref name="Mimphs" /> the ninth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series, which first aired on [[October 18]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}.</ref>
